categories.name: Banking and finance
categories.description: Major banks, brokerages and card issuers (US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia). Each domain also covers its subdomains.

categories.name: Payments
categories.description: Payment processors, wallets and money transfer services. Each domain also covers its subdomains.

categories.name: Health
categories.description: Patient portals, health insurers and pharmacies. Each domain also covers its subdomains.

categories.name: Government
categories.description: Government and military top-level domains and tax/benefit portals. Patterns starting with *. cover subdomains only.

categories.name: Password managers
categories.description: Password managers and authenticators, whose clients often pin certificates. Each domain also covers its subdomains.

categories.name: OS and software updates
categories.description: Operating-system and browser update services, which verify certificates themselves. Each domain also covers its subdomains.

categories.name: Certificate-pinned apps
categories.description: Push and messaging services whose apps reject an intercepting certificate. Each domain also covers its subdomains.
